cards.name: Surrender to Madness
cards.designIntent: Commit to sustained Voidform offense at the risk of doubled incoming Attack damage, or build around preventing the drawback.

base.text: Enter Voidform for the rest of combat. Take double damage from enemy Attacks. Exhaust.
effects: Enter or extend Voidform for the rest of combat, bypassing Insanity and recovery.
Apply a separate double incoming Attack damage debuff before Block.
Exhaust.

upgrade.summary: Cost reduced to 2; retain the full drawback.

card.text: Enter Voidform for the rest of combat. Take double damage from enemy Attacks. Exhaust.
effects: Enter or extend Voidform for the rest of combat, bypassing Insanity and recovery.
Apply a separate double incoming Attack damage debuff before Block.
Exhaust.

rulesNotes: Permanent means until combat ends; combat reset restores the normal Insanity and recovery lifecycle.
Existing ordinary Voidform is extended, not reapplied; no stacking multipliers or extra entry event.
Ready activation cards become invalid; further Surrender copies are unplayable, including after cleansing the drawback.
Artifact present before application can block exposure. Artifact gained later does not remove it. Orange Pellets can cleanse it without ending Voidform.
Normal Attack damage doubles before Block and combines with other modifiers. HP-loss and non-Attack damage are unchanged; Intangible and other prevention apply normally.
Attack costs fall by one, to a minimum of zero; X costs and Skill/Power costs are unchanged.
Free/duplicated effects cannot apply the bargain twice. The card works without the starter relic.
Proposed relics in relics.md remain unimplemented; their future entry triggers should fire only on a new transition into Voidform.
cards.balanceNotes: Test the exposed and cleansed versions separately, including immediate lethal turns, sustained defense, and future Yogg-Saron synergy.
